download_note: sha256 of the whole corpus.jsonl (all documents), read from the corpus.jsonl.sha256 file beside the local copy and not recomputed in this run; the size is from the file system. Both equal the values recorded for the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977 deposit on 2026-11-06.
converter: A short Python normaliser run outside this repository: the corpus 'text' field (already plain text) taken as-is; line endings normalised, trailing spaces stripped, runs of 3+ newlines collapsed; notice header prepended. The same normaliser reproduces the committed Anti-Discrimination Act 1977 text byte for byte. Tables are as the corpus flattened them and were not re-formed into '| a | b |' rows.
notes: The corpus README says the text of HTML documents was extracted with Inscriptis; the Act's text here is that extraction, normalised only for whitespace.

The corpus text carries no contents list, so the section count could not be compared with the Act's own contents list; the section numbering was checked for gaps instead (99 single section headings plus three range headings for repealed sections).
Three repealed runs appear as one heading each, as the corpus shows them: '21A, 21B (Repealed)', '54–57 (Repealed)' and '84–91 (Repealed)'. Part 9 and Part 12 carry no title in the corpus text.
Schedule 2 (Repeals) is flattened to one line per row, with no table markup.
The corpus document is the version dated 2024-11-21 as collected on 2025-03-10; whether the official register holds a later version could not be checked because the register returned a bot challenge.
